compute_mesh_normal_consistency_loss: compute the normal consistency loss for a batch of PyTorch3D meshes using cosine similarity of neighboring face normals
evaluate_mesh_smoothness: evaluate mesh smoothness by measuring how consistent adjacent face normals are across shared edges
detect_mesh_normal_inconsistencies: detect regions where neighboring face normals point in opposite directions indicating mesh quality issues
optimize_mesh_geometry: optimize 3D mesh geometry by minimizing the normal consistency loss during training
validate_mesh_topology: validate mesh topology by checking that adjacent faces share consistent normal directions
